# Kotoba-Lab

**Current v9 highlight:** A standalone Kanji library now searches and filters all 6,813 dictionary kanji without requiring text. Every result opens the shared, component-colored Radical Tree, while the existing Read, Review, and My Words doorways remain unchanged.

> Project home · [[Vibe Coding|Vibe Coding]] · [[PROJECT-CATALOG|Project Catalog]]

Browser-based Japanese reading & text analysis — kanji/word frequency, JLPT-level breakdown, readability estimate, furigana + JLPT-colored reading, click-to-meaning backed by a real dictionary (6,813 kanji with on'yomi/kun'yomi/strokes; ~10.8k words with multi-sense glosses — extracted from Kanjium/EDRDG, CC BY-SA 4.0, see `data/ATTRIBUTION.md`), `.txt`/Aozora-Bunko import (Shift-JIS + markup cleanup), and Anki (TSV) flashcard export. A **My Words** tab adds a persistent study deck plus known-word/kanji tracking (localStorage only) and a personal coverage meter on Analyze; a **Review** tab drills that deck with SM-2-lite spaced repetition (keyboard grading, interval previews, due badge, study streak). Two tokenizers behind one contract: an instant dictionary segmenter, or opt-in `kuromoji` (vendored under `vendor/kuromoji/`, loads once) for real morphology. Static, offline, no AI. Consolidates the legacy desktop `Japanese-Text-Analysis-Tool` + `WordFrequency` (C#/WinForms/MeCab). Tier-A on `ui-system` with the new `washi-sumi` palette.

**Portfolio status:** Active
